messages.author: c35d90904ba3a8a5
messages.subject: Problem with shiny and R.3.0
parts:
Having a typical update on my linux 10.04, the following error came up!any thoughts how can i downgrade R or maybe how shiny can be updated?

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error: package ‘shiny’ was built before R 3.0.0: please re-install it Execution halted

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Problem with shiny and R.3.0
parts:
You can update shiny the usual way, with:
  install.packages('shiny')

Probably all of your other installed packages will run into this problem as well.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Problem with shiny and R.3.0
parts:
It looks like your R was upgraded to 3.0. Maybe you have automatic package upgrades enabled on your system?

To make it work, you'll need to re-install shiny, and caTools, and all other packages it complains about.

-Winston
